I am a Master of Science in Civic Analytics student
at the University of Illinois Chicago with an interest
in using data to address challenges in public service.
My experience includes quantitative research, data
analysis, and communicating findings through data
visualization. I am particularly interested in
transportation, civic technology, and data-informed
decision-making. My goal is to make complex information
accessible and useful to organizations and communities.
